Features.section_title: Everything resellers need to sell digital goods
Features.section_description: A focused toolkit for storefronts, payments, and payouts — without turning the hub into a public marketplace directory.
Features.feature1_description: Register a store with a custom slug and brand it. Buyers only reach it through the link you share.
Features.feature2_description: Links like /toko-satu stay private to your channels. No public store browser on the landing page.
Features.feature3_description: Accept payments through Duitku — virtual accounts, QRIS, and e-wallets popular in Indonesia.
Features.feature4_description: Paid orders credit your wallet ledger so sales and withdrawals stay auditable.
Features.feature5_description: Revenue model is simple: no monthly lock-in on the hub. Platform takes 5% only when you withdraw.
Features.feature6_description: Interface available in Bahasa Indonesia and English with automatic language preference detection.

HowItWorks.section_description: Four clear steps. No public marketplace clutter — just your store and your customers.
HowItWorks.step1_description: Sign up as a reseller and claim your store profile in the dashboard.
HowItWorks.step2_description: Add digital listings with price, description, and status. MVP focuses on listing + checkout.
HowItWorks.step3_description: Send rppmarket.com/your-store to buyers. The hub landing never exposes a store directory.
HowItWorks.step4_description: Buyers pay via Duitku. Balance lands in your wallet. Withdraw with a 5% platform fee.

Pricing.section_title: Earn first. Fee only on withdraw.
Pricing.section_description: RPP Market is not a monthly SaaS plan wall. The platform earns when resellers cash out.
Pricing.model_description: Start free. Build your store, sell products, then withdraw earnings when you are ready.
Pricing.note_body: Resellers keep momentum without paying subscription rent. The hub aligns with your success — fee is charged when money leaves the platform.

FAQ.section_description: Straight answers about stores, discovery, payments, and fees.
FAQ.q1_question: Can buyers browse all stores from the homepage?
FAQ.q1_answer: No. RPP Market is a hub, not a public marketplace directory. Each reseller shares their own store link such as /toko-satu.
FAQ.q2_question: What can I sell in the MVP?
FAQ.q2_answer: Digital listings with checkout. Delivery can be handled manually by the reseller. Automated delivery is planned later.
FAQ.q3_answer: Duitku. Buyers can pay through supported Indonesian methods like VA, QRIS, and e-wallets depending on your Duitku project setup.
FAQ.q4_question: When does RPP Market take a fee?
FAQ.q4_answer: On withdraw only. The platform fee is a flat 5% of the withdrawn amount. Example: withdraw Rp 100.000 → fee Rp 5.000 → net Rp 95.000.
FAQ.q5_answer: Yes. Bahasa Indonesia and English are supported, with automatic preference detection from browser language and location signals when available.
FAQ.q6_question: Do I need a paid subscription to start?
FAQ.q6_answer: No monthly subscription is required for the core hub model. Create a store, sell, then withdraw with the platform fee.

TermsPage.meta_description: Terms of service for using RPP Market.
TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.service_body: RPP Market is a digital store hub for resellers and agents. Each seller gets one storefront with a shareable link. RPP Market is not a public marketplace directory: buyers arrive through links shared by the seller.
TermsPage.seller_body: Sellers are fully responsible for the legality, quality, and delivery of the digital products they sell, including the delivery content shown to buyers after payment. Products that violate Indonesian law or third-party rights are prohibited and may lead to store suspension.
TermsPage.buyer_body: Buyers transact directly with the seller. Complaints, refunds, and warranties are resolved between buyer and seller. Keep your order status page — it contains the digital product you purchased.
TermsPage.fees_body: There is no monthly fee. The platform charges a 5% fee on seller balance withdrawals. Minimum withdrawal is Rp 50,000. Fee rates may change with prior notice.
TermsPage.payments_body: Payments are processed by Duitku (VA, QRIS, e-wallets). Paid order funds are credited to the seller’s store balance and can be withdrawn to a bank account through a manual withdrawal process.
TermsPage.liability_body: The service is provided as is. RPP Market is not liable for indirect losses arising from use of the service, seller product content, or third-party outages (including the payment gateway).
TermsPage.changes_body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes means you accept the new terms.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.collected_body: Seller accounts (name, email) are managed through Clerk. For orders we store the buyer’s name, email, optional phone number, and order details. For withdrawals we store the seller’s bank account details. We also log payment events from the gateway.
PrivacyPage.usage_body: Data is used to process orders and payments, credit seller balances, process withdrawals, prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.
PrivacyPage.third_parties_body: We use Clerk (authentication), Duitku (payments), and hosting providers to run the service. Each processes data under its own privacy policy.
PrivacyPage.retention_body: Order data and financial records (ledger) are retained as long as needed for audits, reconciliation, and legal obligations. Account data is deleted when an account is closed, except financial records we are required to keep.
PrivacyPage.rights_body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Contact us via the email below.
